description_for_human: Read live Azure FinOps evidence within the user's RBAC scope.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to discover the signed-in user's Azure tenant and subscriptions and to run bounded, read-only FinOps reports backed by live Azure APIs. Never infer tenant values without calling a function.

functions.name: listTenants
functions.description: Lists Azure tenants accessible to the signed-in user.

functions.name: listSubscriptions
functions.description: Lists Azure subscriptions accessible to the signed-in user.

functions.name: runFinOpsReport
functions.description: Runs a bounded read-only live Azure FinOps report for an explicit tenant, subscription scope, domain, and optional date range.

instructions: Use only values returned by the function.
State source timestamps, data quality, warnings, and whether rows were truncated.
Do not present estimated savings as guaranteed savings.

conversation_starters.title: Accessible subscriptions
conversation_starters.text: Which Azure subscriptions can I analyze?

conversation_starters.title: Optimization evidence
conversation_starters.text: Run a live optimization report for my selected subscription.
